metadata.description: A collection of professional AI skills, agents, commands, and hooks, packaged as Claude and Codex plugins and deployable globally across vendors or per project.

plugins.name: knowledge_management
plugins.description: Skills and agents for building, maintaining, and distilling a persistent, interlinked knowledge base. Ships the wiki, wiki_wrapup, wiki_import, wiki_fix, executive_summary, and spr skills, and the auto_shaper_wiki agent.

plugins.name: ai_dev
plugins.description: Skills for everyday AI-assisted development: structured git commits, day-grouped changelog maintenance, project-local task and todo tracking as plain-markdown files (a base task skill plus create, check, select, implement, audit, finish, and fix siblings), writing and formatting AI instructions (prompts, rules, skill files, agent definitions), harness portability for bundled scripts and plugin wiring, and language style guides for markdown, Python, and Rust.
